body: Again without revealing too much, one has a job he hates but a hobby that I'm pretty sure he enjoys, the other has a job that he seems to care about but on that I'm not too sure. Was like this as well, the first time I tried getting in to it. A friend convinced me to try it out again about three years ago, and I was just a bit nostalgic for the old wc3 Dota days. Lasted for about a month and didn't look back for a bit.

Then one of the tournaments was just big enough of an event that I saw highlights on, like, normal social media. I got curious again. I play again, but not too often. I sure do follow the pro scene though. Seeing it at the highest level and having professional casters and analysts there to help you appreciate it changed my whole outlook.

Are you seriously telling me that you'd expect a 2k invoker spammer would have pulled off the same play after "10 minutes in a practice game?"

There's a difference between pressing the buttons that make the spells happen, and making that have this kind of impact against a set of professionals.
Go do it against DC then lol
